title: A completely worry-free family trip
quote: This was our second time choosing Joy at Hidden China Travel, and he exceeded our expectations again. Yunnan was amazing: the scenery, the food, and how little we had to organize ourselves. Joy even got us business-class train tickets when we upgraded at short notice, and our driver-guide was easy to talk with the whole way.
name: Daniel & Sarah L.

title: Professional, reliable, and flexible
quote: Joy organized our private Yunnan journey, and the places he recommended were stunning, including Shangri-La, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, and Yuhu Village. The trains got hectic for a moment, and he sorted them out. Our whole family is grateful for his help.
name: The Tan Family

title: Our driver-guide made the journey fun
quote: This was our first time bringing our young son to China, and it was a wonderful experience. Our driver-guide was humorous, friendly, and knowledgeable, with stories about Yunnan and its ethnic minorities that our family wanted to hear. Meals were comfortable, and we came home with very good memories.
name: Rachel & Kevin M.

title: A wonderful honeymoon stop in Yunnan
quote: We are a newlywed couple visiting China for our honeymoon, and Yunnan was one of the stops on our trip. Joy was incredibly patient and responsible in helping us plan our Yunnan itinerary; he also provided plenty of advice on pre-trip preparations and suggestions for visiting other destinations. We ended up having a wonderful time!
name: Faisal & Aisha R.

title: Vegetarian needs well taken care of
quote: I joined this private journey to experience life in Yunnan, even after years of British Columbia scenery. Joy arranged the days so I did not have to manage the schedule. He also arranged a separate table and excellent vegetarian meals for those of us who needed them.
name: Emily C.

title: A professional, patient, and funny driver-guide
quote: The Hidden China Travel team was easy to reach before and during the journey. Our driver-guide was professional, patient, and funny, and the driving was cautious and punctual. The hotels were either charming guesthouses or very comfortable, and we recommend them.
name: Claire & Thomas

title: Tiger Leaping Gorge private journey
quote: The private journey was fantastic. We saw beautiful scenery and spent time with ethnic minority cultures. Our driver-guide drove steadily, was kind and patient, and looked after us properly. Yunnan is truly beautiful.
name: Mark & Susan T.

title: The best driver-guide I’ve had
quote: Our driver-guide in Lijiang was the best I have traveled with: professional, kind, flexible, and calm. I was with my family, her English was excellent, and her manner made us feel at home. I recommend the Hidden China Travel team.
name: Michelle H.

title: Patient guiding while traveling with children
quote: We are grateful for our driver-guide’s patience, especially when traveling with children made the days a bit stressful. The service stayed dedicated the whole way. Five stars from us.
name: David & Emma R.

title: A Yunnan journey that exceeded expectations
quote: I finished an 8-day private journey with Hidden China Travel, from Kunming to Dali, Lijiang, and Shangri-La. I felt happy and relaxed every day, and Yunnan itself is stunning. I completely fell in love with it.
name: Peter & Jenny K.
